HAPPY SKY Scene Atlas

Every screen of beatmania IIDX 12 HAPPY SKY that draws a 3D model, what it draws, how it moves, which player choices change it, and what the 573Renderer scene preset module still lacks to reproduce it. Read out of JAD\bm2dx.exe with IDA (headless idalib session) by a multi-agent sweep on 2026-08-18.

Build JAD, bm2dx.exe 1105920 bytes, CRC32 0x122D2CC3 (not yet in GameFingerprint) Renderer Direct3D 8, 640x480 R5G6B5, D16, 60 Hz Model slots 11 bound at boot (of 16) 3D screens 5 (6 presets incl. EXTRA STAGE) 2D-only candidates title, card in

What changed since RED. Title / attract, card in and the play screen draw no model on HAPPY SKY, and no screen inherits a visible slot: every screen shows its models itself and hides them on exit (55 SetVisible call sites in 20 functions, all classified). The models are no longer emblems spinning in front of the camera but full sky / sea backdrops seen from inside, and the screens lean on engine state RED never had: fog, a per-frame clear colour, ambient and specular light channels, and a second immediate-mode 3D pass.

Unbound on disk: sky/muyaji.xz (no reference anywhere in the executable, searched string table and every model path). tranbox/tran_box.xz is bound only by the operator test menu viewer, which also names music/music_bg.xz and core/core.xz directories that do not exist on this install. mdlview.bin is a flat model-viewer index (6 scenes, 12 models), not a screen binding.

The thumbnails use the renderer's default camera. Every IIDX 12 model carries an authored Frame2_Camera that Scene3d::FindCamera never matches (it looks for lowercase "camera"); the game ignores those frames too and drives the view from code, so the presets must carry explicit cameras, as the RED presets do.

Engine facts that apply to every screen

  • Same model-scene library as IIDX 10 / RED, recompiled: slot API offsets unchanged (+804 visible, +156 speed, +164 time, +176 mode, +192 alpha), idc573/iidx10/model_scene.idc resolves everything unchanged.
  • Rotations are radians passed raw to D3DX; rotation order X, then Z, then Y.
  • Draw-mode table byte-identical to RED: 0/1 opaque, 2 SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA, 3 additive, 4 reverse subtract. Modes 2..4 are collected and depth sorted after the opaque pass. SPECULARENABLE = 0 in the base block, so light specular is inert on models.
  • The per-slot tint (RGBA at obj+180..192, alpha set by sub_495480) is multiplied into each subset's material diffuse before the draw. Modes 0/1 use ALPHAOP = SELECTARG1(TEXTURE), so an alpha on an opaque slot is inert; modes 2..4 use MODULATE, so their alphas are real (verified on dan select, sub_498370 / sub_498C60).
  • Anim time advances once per drawn frame regardless of visibility (only reader of +804 is the render loop and the advance sits outside it).
  • Frame order (sub_447E60): Clear(clear colour) → movie blit at 31 → 2D priorities 31, 30 → fog apply → model scene → poly_draw → fog off → 2D priorities 29..0. So the 3D sits exactly between 2D priority 30 and 29 (higher = further back).
  • Projection defaults from the device init: fov 1.0471976, aspect 640/480, near 0.1, far 500. Only five functions in the image call the projection setter (mode select x2, music select, dan select, expert select).
  • Light setters: sub_4962A0(enable,i), sub_4962E0 diffuse (+4), sub_496310 ambient (+36), sub_496340 specular (+20), sub_496370 direction (+64); records are 104-byte D3DLIGHT8 at 0x1C31740.
  • Package selection is by name (\sys\%s\system.idx, 199 baked paths); the numbered dirs are per-song BGA packages. system.idx parses with the renderer's existing SysIdx reader (198/198, middle name table empty on every package).

17 entries, no KAIDEN. Frame-0 camera eye (0, 0.06, -0.45) at (0, 0.16, 0). Slot 6 uses the literal 3.14 (0x4048F5C3), not pi. Verified (dan_select_verify.md): the tint RGBA at obj+180..192 is multiplied into the material diffuse per subset, and mode 0's stage table uses ALPHAOP SELECTARG1(TEXTURE), so slot 5's alpha 0.1 is inert (draw it opaque) while the mode 3 alphas (slots 3, 4, 6, 8) are real. Corrections: the DECIDE camera at is (0, -1.0, 0); light 5 is off for the whole DECIDE phase (poly_draw disables it each frame and nothing re-enables it once sub_42D510 stops); GRADE_BLACK1 is two 640x138 subtract vignette bands, not a full pane, so DAN_IN is dropped as a whole for chrome reasons only; DAN_BG's scroll is unproven (the samples show a 6x zoom settling by frame 199), sample densely before authoring; the decide branch runs 242 frames.

Ending

3D, camera, fog

slot 0 sky (sub_42FB10): hidden, alpha 0.5, mode 2, pos 0, rot 0, scale 1, speed 1.0, time 0
per frame (sub_42FE30): show once f >= 200 ; speed = f < 4833 ? 1.0 : 1.0 + 0.025 * (f - 4832)   (7.975 on the last frame 5111)
camera: eye (0,0,0) at (0,0,1) fixed ; up starts (1,0,0) and is rotated 0.2 deg about z EVERY frame,
        pivot at the eye, result written back (integrates: 1 turn / 30 s, 2.85 turns over the ending)
projection: inherited
fog (sub_42F9F0): colour 0x0FFFFFFF (white), density 0.1, start 50.0, end 80.0, ON  (far rim of the dome fades into the white clear)
clear colour: 0x00FFFFFF every frame with no input (the RGB debug sliders need key input)
lights: none set here. Route dependent: after the play loop, mode select's light 0 is still on;
        after DAN select, sub_42DF30 has disabled 0/1/2/5, so NO light is on. Slot 0 is drawn lit either way (mode 2, LIGHTING on)
exit at f 5111: slot 0 hidden, fog off, clear 0, movie stopped

poly_draw tile grid (sub_4300D0, from f 200)

9 quads in a 3 x 3 grid, each with its own world matrix and D3DMATERIAL8, submitted to poly_draw queue B
texture = the BGA movie frame (304 x 416 in a 512 texture, UV 0.59375 x 0.8125); movie = last played song's
  BGA or "MMSS.4" random on a fresh boot; missing file falls back to data\movie\08ra.4 ; the movie is NOT blitted as 2D here
spin about own centre and orbit the scene centre at rates proportional to the frame counter;
4 x 4 jitter lattice: 16 CRT rand() draws at init jitter the 12 non-corner points (rows 1..2 in y, columns 1..2 in x) ;
from f 4833 a burst counter (+2.0/f) sends the tiles at the camera
drawn after the model scene, alpha blended, in SUBMISSION order (queue B is not depth sorted), UNLIT (light 5 is never on,
so LIGHTING is forced off for the pass; the material and normals do not matter), inside the fog bracket.
"REAL_TEXTURE" is a magic name that takes the texture from the queue entry: with no movie the tiles draw untextured.

The RED-style beat grids, position jitter and particle bursts do not exist here. Correction to the RED notes. sub_49C140 on RED writes D3DLIGHT8.Ambient (+36), not specular. The IIDX 10 / RED presets that record "white specular" are recording white ambient; if the renderer applied it as specular the ambient term is missing there. Worth re-checking those documents when the light channel is extended.

Unchanged and verified: the 2D display list, the six blit kinds, the registration API (sub_40E030(scene, pkg, name, mode, x, y, priority), mode 0 = once and vanish, 1 = loop, 16 = once and hold), the cell-substitution callback, the text renderer, the package format. No render targets or post effects anywhere.

Renderer readiness what already works

  • 3D: --scene3d-test renders every scene dir today (all six thumbnails above), no profile needed.
  • 2D: --gc2d-sheet reads every IIDX 12 package (title 208 PNGs, mselect 395, mode 191, expert, dan_e, ending, card, gameover, name, plus a BGA package smoke test).
  • Textures are plain LZSS .gcz like RED, not Blowfish like DistorteD.
  • Blockers for presets: (a) GameFingerprint has no row for bm2dx.exe 1105920 / CRC32 0x122D2CC3, so --preset-test exits 2; (b) directory auto-detection maps "IIDX 12 - HAPPY SKY" to the generic iidx33 profile (the "iidx" substring) and boot dies looking for avs2-core.dll; --profile iidx13 boots. A dedicated iidx12 profile / substring is needed.

Implementation plan milestones M1 to M8, in the style of the scene preset editor plan

Each milestone lands as one commit on feature/fixes, gated by bash tools/checks.sh, built tests-first (the failing test is quoted before the fix), and reviewed by an independent Opus pass that looks at the rendered screen. Every milestone also grows the durable RE document IIDX/happy_sky_3d_screens.md in the notes repo (the sweep reports under IIDX/happy_sky_re/ are the drafts it is distilled from), and every new command or parameter is added to docs/preset_document.md, its FieldsFor row and the editor forms in the same change, so the editor can author it. Presets carry background art only (docs/preset_layers.md); every state below needs a docs/preset_states.md row and every layer a preset_layers.md row, and the CI gates check both.

Status (2026-08-19): M1 to M8 are implemented, gate green (847 ci tests), each independently reviewed (Opus) with all findings fixed; the tree is uncommitted on feature/fixes. Corrections the implementation produced on top of the sweep: the expert clear colour breathes blue (0,48,96) to red (96,0,0) (disassembly of sub_432C10); music select eye x is -0.074308 (0xBD982ECB); the dan bubble cell is AWA1 in the system package, its RNG is the Knuth generator, the dan timer is 1260 and DAN_BG zooms in then holds; the ending movie player holds its last frame and runs on the DirectShow reference clock; RED and IIDX 10 set white AMBIENT (not specular) on their title lights and the presets now record that; and, found in the M8 review, the per-light ambient is INERT on every one of these games because D3DXLoadMeshFromXof writes every material ambient as (0,0,0,1) and nothing changes it, so the renderer now keeps its material ambient black (it used to copy the diffuse, which only mattered once a document carried white light ambient) and models are lit by diffuse plus emissive only, as in the game. Open decisions for the user: the ending plate ENDING_BG has captions baked in and is not carried (docs/preset_layers.md records the one-clip change); the attract now shows the game's full title content (wordmark, strapline, advert block, version marks) and hides only the INSERT COIN blinker, by user decision on 2026-08-19; also fixed 2026-08-19 after the user saw the music-select sky freeze: every key track now loops on its own last key time (the game's samplers fmod the slot clock per track; the renderer used to hold a track's last key until the scene's longest clip wrapped, which also froze RED's 60-tick emblem clips three quarters of the time), and a scene's loop length is the LCM of its tracks. Nothing is committed yet.

M1 HAPPY SKY plumbing, clear colour, light channels

Scope

  • GameFingerprint row iidx12 (IIDX 12 HAPPY SKY, JAD, bm2dx.exe 1105920 bytes, CRC32 0x122D2CC3) and a GameProfile entry iidx12 (dir substring "happy sky", scene3d, 640x480, bm2dx.exe) placed before the generic "iidx" entry; the profile section in docs/game_profiles.md.
  • Document-level render.clear_color (RGB 0..1, default black) in RenderSpec, JSON, fields, validation, the Document properties modal; render.settings.clear_color as an optional, TWEENABLE parameter and clear_color as a param.override id, resolved into FrameState and pushed as a new PushCall::SetClearColor. The scene3d backend applies it to the frame clear (D3D9State::clear_color, alpha 0) every frame from PresetHost, live and during export, EXCEPT while an export with a transparent background runs (the game's clear is backdrop and is dropped with the rest of it, so the coverage-derived alpha keeps working). Existing documents keep black, so nothing changes for IIDX 10 / RED.
  • ambient channel on document lights[], light.set (tweenable), light[i].ambient override id, LightPush and Scene3d::Light, reaching D3DLIGHT9.Ambient; default black so the golden pushes of the converted presets are byte-identical (the RED ambient re-check is M8, not here). specular stays and is documented as inert on models (SPECULARENABLE 0, as in the game).
  • Light indices: the document lights array and light.set.index accept 0..7 (HAPPY SKY drives 0, 1, 2, 5); the renderer's ApplyLights keeps disabling every slot it used.

Tests first

  • tests/game/game_fingerprint_tests.cpp: a temp dir with a 1105920-byte bm2dx.exe whose CRC32 is 0x122D2CC3 identifies as iidx12; a same-size wrong-CRC file reports the patched-copy path; GameProfile::AutoDetect on a path containing "IIDX 12 - HAPPY SKY" returns slug iidx12, not iidx33, and "distorted" still returns iidx13.
  • preset_json_tests.cpp: render.clear_color round-trips, is omitted when black, rejects a 4-component or out-of-range value; light.set.ambient and lights[].ambient round-trip; a key on render.settings.clear_color validates and one on sprite_split_priority still fails.
  • preset_eval_tests.cpp: a render.settings clip with clear_color keys ((0,48,96)/255 at 0, (96,0,0)/255 at 2700, back at 5400) resolves the mid-point exactly and pushes SetClearColor once per frame with the resolved value; a param.override clear_color wins over the document value for the clip's frames; light.set with ambient pushes it, without it pushes black.
  • Golden: preset_defaults_golden_tests.cpp still passes with the fixture frozen (no push text changes for the 18 converted presets).
  • Backend: with a preset active whose clear colour is white, the frame's cleared pixel is white in a live capture and black in a transparent-background export capture (host-level test on the clear colour the backend hands to D3D9State, since CI has no device).

Docs and CI

  • docs/preset_document.md (top level, render.settings, light.set, param id grammar), docs/game_profiles.md, docs/preset_golden.md tolerated-differences note if any, IIDX/happy_sky_3d_screens.md created with the slot table, engine facts and the light setter identities.

M3 Mode select preset and the sin(t) camera fly-in

Scope

  • DECIDED: no new ease. The fly-in is a camera.tween with a key per frame from 0 to 40 (linear between integer frames is exact at integer frames, and the game only ever samples integer frames); the value holds after the last key. A sine_arg ease would have needed a 39.6-frame span to match t = f * 0.025252523 and could not be exact.
  • iidx12-mode-select: mode_bg harfsky opaque, camera fly-in (at linear, eye on sin(t) over 40 frames from (0,0.3,0)/(0,0.4340612,0) to (0,0.0302638,-0.2755064)/(0,0.4340612,0.9008834), authored as the game float bits), fov -4.7528005 with aspect auto (the device 640/480), near 0.1, far 500, light 0 (dir (1,1,1), diffuse white, ambient white, specular 0), clear white, length 1201, markers at 0 (fly in) and 40 (settled).

Tests first

  • eval tween test for sine_arg at t = 0, 0.5, 1 against sin(); defaults test: eye at frames 0, 20, 40, 100 equals the transcribed formula; the negative fov reaches the projection push unclamped (soft range).

M4 Music select preset, fog, the EXTRA STAGE option and the clear-colour strobe

Scope

  • scene.fog command (scene track primary, its own family): enabled, color, start, end, density; pushed as SetFog; Scene3d::Renderer applies linear vertex fog with RANGEFOGENABLE around the model pass only (never the 2D). Document-level default: disabled.
  • render.clear_cycle command (scene track modifier over render.settings): the exact integer machinery of sub_41E1F0: base, strobe_color, strobe_period, strobe_windows, strobe_skip_every, ramp_period, ramp_length, ramp_peak, evaluated with C integer division on the document frame.
  • iidx12-music-select with option stage = NORMAL | EXTRA: NORMAL shows sky (opaque) + muring (additive 0.2) with the rolled-up camera, fog white 55..62.4 density 0.5, clear white; EXTRA shows extra_bg (additive, speed 2) with the (-0.2,-0.2,-0.2) camera, fog off, black clear plus the strobe/ramp cycle. Length 1800, marker at 60 (song list fades in; no 2D carried).

Tests first

  • fog push test; clear-cycle unit test reproducing frames 0, 24, 25, 299, 300, 314, 315, 799, 800 of the formula bit-exactly; option switch test that the camera, fog and clear change together; --preset-option stage=EXTRA renders.

M5 Class course (dan) select preset, camera ease, grade option, bubbles

Scope

  • camera.ease command (camera track modifier): per-frame exponential ease toward a target on a chosen axis mask with a rate and a start frame, target and rate overridable per option choice; and the same for a scalar channel: model.ease (target scale / position with rate) or, if the review prefers, per-choice transcribed keys with the ease baked in (the report keeps both formulas).
  • emitter gains burst_period_min/max, burst_count and a linear drift so the AWA1 bubbles (3 or 5 per burst, period 10..14, bottom to top) are expressible with the game's RNG stream.
  • iidx12-dan-select: six models (dan_sky opaque; dan_sky2 additive speed 0.3; dan_sea additive 0.8; dan_sea2 opaque; dan_sea2 second instance additive 0.8, rot x 3.14, y -0.01; dan_light_bg additive, rot x 1.0, z -0.6, speed 0.2), lights 5, 0, 2, 1 (diffuse + ambient white, specular (0,0.5,1)), fov 1.0471976 with 1.3333334 / 0.1 / 500, black clear, DAN_BG at priority 30 behind the 3D, option grade = CLASS 7..1 | 1ST..8TH DAN | 9TH..10TH DAN driving the camera target (0,0.076023,-0.2)/(0,0.18,0) etc., the shared sky scale 1.0 or 3.5 with y (1-s)*0.033333335, slot 8 alpha 0 or 0.6, and the bubble emitter on the third choice. Renderer: the second dan_sea2 instance needs per-instance model names (RED's second r_side was skipped for this reason; fix it here or record it).

Tests first

  • camera.ease converges to the target within tolerance after 60 frames at 0.05 and 19 at 0.15, only on the masked axes; option change re-targets without snapping; DAN_BG resolves behind the split priority; the bubble emitter draws N per burst on the right frames for a fixed seed.

M6 Ending preset, rolling camera, poly_draw movie tiles

Scope

  • camera.set.roll_per_frame (degrees, integrating, about z, pivot eye) or a camera.motion modifier; model.tween anim_speed ramp 1.0 to 7.975 over 4833..5111.
  • polydraw.grid command (new track kind poly): the 3 x 3 movie tile grid as data (lattice jitter from 16 CRT rand draws, spin and orbit rates, burst counter from frame 4833, material) with a texture source parameter (movie file, default data/movie/08ra.4, plus none = untextured) exposed as a preset option; drawn after the model scene, alpha blended, unlit, submission order, inside the fog bracket. Needs a movie frame decoder for the .4 container (research: what codec; the renderer already has media decoders, see docs/media_formats.md).
  • iidx12-ending: sky slot mode 2 alpha 0.5 visible from 200, fog white 50..80 density 0.1, clear white, ENDING_BG (END_BG1) bloom-in and 200..300 cross-fade with its baked captions accepted or the clip started at 200 (user decides), length 5112, markers at 0, 200, 300, 4833, 5077.

Tests first

  • roll integration test (up after 150 frames = 30 deg from +X toward -Y); tile geometry test at frame 200 and 4833 for the fixed lattice seed; movie-less run draws untextured tiles; the frame count is 5112.

M7 2D-only presets: title attract and card in

  • iidx12-attract: TITLE (hold) 0..422, LOGO_IN (hold) 423..543, TITLE_TAIKI loop from 544, priority 15, black clear, everything the package draws kept (user decision: the attract shows the game's title content) except the X_COIN_BRINK coin prompt; the system tickers, debug text and callback-filled cells are not carried; length 2461. iidx12-card-in: CARD_BG mode hold priority 31, hidden_parts T_REMAIN, length 3600. Layer rows in preset_layers.md from rendered sheets.

M8 RED and IIDX 10 light ambient re-check

  • The RED notes recorded sub_49C140 as specular; it is ambient (+36). Re-read the IIDX 10 and RED light rigs, move the white from specular to ambient in their defaults where the game did, re-record the golden fixture deliberately (documented in docs/preset_golden.md) and compare against a live capture of the game. Separate milestone so M1 stays byte-identical for the existing presets.
